newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norwegian shares down with rest of Europe.
newsitem.headline: Norwegian shares down with rest of Europe.

text.p: Norwegian shares eased back on Wednesday in line with major European bourses with most blue chip stock finishing lower.
The Total share index, which rose 0.47 percent on Tuesday, closed 0.26 percent off at 1,103.45 points. Turnover was heavy at 1.3 billion crowns.
Several industrial groups lost ground, including Aker RGI , Norske Skog, Elkem, Norsk Hydro and Kvaerner.
The Oslo Bourse, helped by a strong crown and low interest rates, has gained about 14 percent so far this year.
Despite the bull run, many analysts say they believe the market will continue to perform well medium term.
"We see a strong Norwegian market in the next three to six months," one Oslo-based analyst said.
"This is mainly because liquidity in the stock market still is very strong and there continues to be a net cash flow from abroad into the Norwegian market," the analyst said.
